notes: Track-as: re-confirmed the Log screen control and the exercise detail modal both save the mode override through one shared path with no id-length gate, so Bench Press id 73 and every 9-99 id persists
publish.py now sets JAVA_HOME to the JDK 17 and ANDROID_HOME/ANDROID_SDK_ROOT to the SDK root, and fails loudly if either is missing, so a release no longer needs the shell pre-configured
Next-session target now merges an exercise's cards within a session, so an exercise logged twice in one workout counts as one session and its trend is no longer measured against its own second card
Custom exercises can be renamed and deleted from the exercise detail modal; deleting keeps the logged sets but detaches them from the muscle-group analysis
Data screen: a clearly-labelled, confirm-guarded 'Restore from file (replace all)' now sits beside Import (merge), and its confirmation names exactly what will be lost
A brand-new account now shows an empty Consistency card instead of a year of empty cells, and the 'Load my 7 Nov session' button is reachable again
